name: user stop
label: User stop
when: The user said STOP, by voice, touch or button, at any trust. It holds until a trusted GO.
why: A stop from the user is obeyed even when the speech recogniser is unsure: stopping is always safe.

name: drop
label: Drop
when: Any one trusted sensor measures a drop within 0.5 m (edge_m), or stairs going down there that only one sensor sees.
why: A fall needs no second opinion, so one sensor is enough to stop. The stop needs a measured distance.

name: obstacle
label: Obstacle
when: A trusted obstacle within 0.8 m (obstacle_stop_m), from any sensor.
why: As for a drop, one sensor is enough to stop.

name: lone step
label: Lone step
when: A step up or a curb measured within 0.5 m that no second sensor confirms, as when the camera cannot be trusted in the dark. Not on tracks, nor when the user has chosen tracks in manual mode.
does: Stops; the user can choose tracks to cross.
why: One sensor cannot change the mode, but it can stop the chair before it rolls onto a step on wheels (#103).

name: stairs down
label: Stairs down
when: Two sensors agree there are stairs going down, and the user has not said yes to them.
says: Stairs down ahead. Say yes to go down on tracks
why: Stairs going down are the one change of mode MANA does not make on its own.

name: going down
label: Going down
when: The same stairs, after a trusted yes that no NO or STOP has taken back.
says: Going down the stairs on tracks
why: The yes lapses 1.5 s after the stairs leave view, so the next stairs are asked about again.

name: manual
label: Manual
when: The user chose manual mode: by voice, with a speed command, or by choosing wheels or tracks.
does: The user's mode and speed. With no ground sensor at all, the user's mode at 30% at most, saying "Ground sensors not available, slowing down" (D7).
why: Every branch above this one still holds in manual mode: the user drives, but not over an edge or into an obstacle.

name: step
label: Step
when: Two different sensors see a step (stairs or a curb), and one of them measures it within 2 m (step_m).
why: A change of mode needs two independent sensors, so a picture of stairs cannot trigger it. For a curb the message is "Curb ahead, changing to tracks".

name: slip
label: Slip
when: The wheels turn faster than the chair moves.
why: Slip is measured on the device itself, from the wheels against its motion.

name: hold tracks
label: Hold tracks
when: On tracks, and the ground has not been level (within about 3 degrees) for 2 s.
says: On tracks until the ground is level
why: Back to wheels only on level ground. Without the IMU's tilt, MANA stays on tracks.

name: no ground
label: No ground
when: No recent, trusted ground report from any sensor.
says: Ground sensors not available, slowing down
why: With no view of the ground, MANA slows down rather than drive blind.

name: slow
label: Slow
when: Something ahead: an obstacle within 2 m, a drop or a ramp within 2 m, or a step that only one sensor sees.
why: The message names what is ahead: "Obstacle ahead", "Drop ahead", "Ramp ahead" or "Possible step ahead", then "slowing down".

name: no alert link
label: No link
when: Neither Wi-Fi nor Bluetooth could carry an alert now: missed heartbeats, or not connected.
why: Without a link, a call for help could not be sent. A device with no link module is not slowed down.

name: no position
label: No position
when: Neither GPS nor the lidar map has a recent, trusted position. Odometry drifts, so it does not count.
why: Without a position, a helper could not be told where the user is.
